messages:
sara: quick follow-up on pinning schema: proposing a 'compat-grouping' feature. idea: control plane can treat a set of small, compatible variant diffs as one logical pin for routing/telemetry for a short TTL to reduce churn for perf/quant-only rollouts.

mike: interesting. biggest worry is silent semantic drift. how do we prove compatibility? should be explicit from model onboarding (e.g. delta on a canonical eval < X).

yun: agree. onboarding emits a compatibility_signature and a compatibility_score. platform runs a lightweight check; we only grant group status when score > threshold. telemetry must still show per-variant metrics.

kevin: schema-level suggestion: add fields to rollout metadata but keep them optional: compat_group_id, compat_ttl_days, compat_mode (enum strict|relaxed), compat_pools (list of pool ids). resolver must deterministically map requests so there's no non-deterministic routing.

rachel: tenant pin precedence is required — we must never override an explicit tenant pin. add tenant opt-out: tenant_settings.allow_compat_grouping=false for regulated tenants.

ops-bot: infra-bot: Canary run launched for variant v3-int8 on canary/2026-03-15 :rocket:

mike: deprecation lifecycle idea: phase=grouped, notice (notify tenants + suggested_migrate), hard-retire (reject with recommended replacement). add deprecation_phase + deprecation_eta fields.

sara: audit note: audit logs must always include exact variant hash used for each inference even when grouped under compat_group_id. group is an ops abstraction, not an audit abstraction.

kevin: implementation note: compute compat_group_id deterministically e.g. sha256(sorted variant hashes + owner id) so backfills and multi-replica lookup agree. also include a coerce-safe fallback when pool mismatch occurs.

yun: autoscaler concern: compat groups that mix incompatible hardware pools must list compat_pools and allow routing to fallback pools. also capture metrics: migration_success_rate, latency_delta, cost_delta, and post-group regression count.

sara: next steps: i'll draft a short RFC + sample rollout metadata and UI copy. will also add playbook for rollback if regression > threshold. aiming to post RFC link later this week.
